ShortDescription.Value: All-in-one cheat and sandbox panel: money, milestones, demand, construction and more.

Publish.LongDescription:
CityForge Reborn is an in-game cheat / sandbox panel for Cities: Skylines II.
- Money: add or remove funds, infinite money - Milestones: advance to a target milestone or unlock everything - Development tree points - Instant construction or adjustable build speed - Per-zone demand overrides with Force Build - Customisable panel colour
